name: @pipeworx/mcp-idaho-code

tools.name: id_statute
tools.description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Idaho Statutes (Idaho Code) by citation. "18-4001" is murder; "32-717" lists child custody factors. Accepts natural forms: "18-4001", "Idaho Code 18-4001", "I.C. § 18-4001". Returns the current statutory text, the official catchline, chapter/title context, and the amendment HISTORY line Idaho prints on nearly every section (e.g. "[18-4001, added 1972, ch. 336, sec. 1, p. 928; am. 1977...]"). Idaho publishes the CURRENT text only — no per-year historical archive of statute text (only session-law PDF volumes organized by session chapter, not by Code citation); this tool says so rather than guessing. Keyless. Use for "what does Idaho Code 18-4001 say" or to check an Idaho statute a case or lease relies on.

citation.description: Section citation, title-number, e.g. "18-4001" (murder) or "55-307" (landlord access to leased premises). Some sections carry a letter suffix, e.g. "18-101A".

tools.name: id_search
tools.description: Search the Idaho Statutes BY TOPIC or keyword rather than citation — "landlord security deposit", "concealed weapon permit", "child custody". Matches against the Idaho Legislature's own official chapter and section CATCHLINES across all ~20,400 sections (not full statutory prose — Idaho does not publish a keyless full-text search API, verified live; its hosted search box has no documented contract). Returns matching citations and catchlines; call id_statute with a citation for the full text. Keyless.

query.description: Topic or keywords, e.g. "landlord security deposit".

limit.description: Max results to return, default 10, max 25.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-idaho-code forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the idaho-code pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
